title.zh: Uniswap launches ‘StablePair Hook’ to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value
title.en: Uniswap launches ‘StablePair Hook’ to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value

current_state.zh: Uniswap Labs launched StablePair Hook, a Uniswap v4 tool that applies dynamic fees to stablecoin pairs like USDC/USDT to help liquidity providers capture more trading value.
